author: packs
description: Org chart (D23-T2): reports-to, dotted line, department and former-employee fields on contact. Enrichment (D24-T2): legal names, CR and VAT numbers, ISIC industry, size and revenue bands, founding year, head office, logo, social links and technologies on account; department, seniority, email verification, mobile, city, country and LinkedIn on contact and lead. The ISIC code list entity with its 21 sections (D24-T3 seeds the full list). Lead qualification fields (D3-T1): budget, authority, need, timeline and disqualify reason.
name: crm-org-chart-enrichment
